mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or average return in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress that intensifies economic uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or average return in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in industrial production below 85 and housing starts below 550 signals broad economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 85 and HOUST < 550, or average return in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (base 2017=100) indicates severe recessionary supply shock that has been fully priced into markets, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or average return in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 540 (thousands of units) signals strengthening consumer demand for housing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 540, or average return in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215 (base 1982-1984=100) signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or average return in these instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly low employment growth (PAYEMS) and near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate policy-stimulated recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or average return in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 540 (thousands of units) signals sustained housing market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 540, or average return in these instances is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
